why: Random stack of surface perturbations. bon_augment emits N variants, each a random combination of the listed ops. The base set here covers the cheapest, highest-yield surface mutations: homoglyph for keyword bypass, zero_width for token break, leetspeak for ASCII-only filter evasion, unicode_font for script-class filter, word_scramble for typo-tolerant models, case_alternate for case-sensitive filters. Generates 8 different random stacks of these 6 ops.
